summary: Frontend changes add improved error humanization and React Query refetching for clue creation, but the diff summary does not show the key backend change needed to align backend admin authorization with the Spectate Portal owner allowlist. Several unrelated UI/routing/theming features appear to have been added beyond the requested Create Clue fix.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend authorization so the Spectate Portal owner principals can successfully create clues (and other admin clue actions) without receiving an "Unauthorized" trap from the canister; non-owners must still be unauthorized; owners must be able to editClue, deleteClue, clearAllClues, reassignClueId without Unauthorized.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows admin-gated methods (createClue/editClue/reassignClueId) still relying on AccessControl.hasPermission/#admin, but the diff summary does not show any implementation that actually maps the Spectate Portal owner principal allowlist (used in the frontend) into the canister's admin set. Without an explicit linkage, owner principals may still trap as Unauthorized. Also, deleteClue and clearAllClues are not shown in the backend excerpt, so their authorization behavior cannot be verified from the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: On Create Clue success: form fields reset and a success toast is shown; on failure: an English human-readable error toast is shown and the error is logged to console; newly created clue appears in Existing Clues without manual refresh.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows (a) refetching clue summaries after create via useCreateClue and (b) console error logging on create failure plus a humanizeError helper, but the provided AdminPage.tsx content is truncated before showing whether success toasts and form reset are implemented, and whether error toasts always use human-readable messages (vs raw errors). Therefore the full AC cannot be confirmed from the diff summary alone.
